book_kraken.name: Kraken XBT/USD order book
book_kraken.method: Top 500 levels per side (may not reach ±2%).

book_bybit.name: Bybit BTC-USDT spot order book

book_okx.name: OKX BTC-USDT order book
book_okx.method: Up to 5000 levels per side. USDT treated as $1.

binance_deriv.name: Binance USDⓈ-M futures API
binance_deriv.method: BTCUSDT perpetual OI, funding. Often geo-blocked from US servers.

bybit_deriv.name: Bybit V5 API
bybit_deriv.method: BTCUSDT linear + BTCUSD inverse perpetual OI and funding. Often geo-blocked from US servers.

deribit_fut.name: Deribit futures
deribit_fut.method: Perpetual + dated futures; OI in USD; basis vs Deribit BTC index.

deribit_opt.name: Deribit options
deribit_opt.method: Per-instrument OI and mark IV. Deribit is the majority of listed BTC options OI but excludes CME/IBIT options.

bitmex.name: BitMEX XBTUSD
bitmex.method: Inverse perpetual; OI in USD contracts.
bitmex.error: XBTUSD reports zero open interest and volume (inactive) — excluded

mempool.name: mempool.space
mempool.method: Hash rate, difficulty, next adjustment estimate.

book_binance.name: Binance BTC-USDT order book
book_binance.method: Up to 5000 levels via data-api.binance.vision. USDT treated as $1.

cftc_cot.name: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures (CME Bitcoin)
cftc_cot.method: CME Bitcoin futures (5 BTC contract) positioning by trader class.

coingecko.name: CoinGecko
coingecko.method: Volume-weighted aggregate spot price across exchanges.

okx_rubik.name: OKX Trading Data (Rubik)
okx_rubik.method: OKX-only aggregate contract OI/volume, long/short account ratio, taker volume.

yahoo.name: Yahoo Finance chart API
yahoo.method: Front-month futures (gold, silver), DXY, Nasdaq-100, S&P 500 closes.

coinmetrics.name: Coin Metrics Community API
coinmetrics.method: On-chain network data (MVRV, realized cap, hash rate, miner revenue, issuance).

hyperliquid.name: Hyperliquid
hyperliquid.method: On-chain perp DEX; OI in BTC × mark; hourly funding scaled to 8h.

fred.name: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
fred.method: Official series: H.4.1 balance sheet, Treasury, rates, spreads, indices.

okx_deriv.name: OKX public derivatives API
okx_deriv.method: Swap + futures OI (USD), funding, liquidation orders.

farside.name: Farside Investors — BTC ETF flows
farside.frequency: daily (US trading days, published evening ET; some funds T+1)
farside.method: US$m net creations/redemptions per fund from issuer data.
farside.note: full-history page failed (HTTP 403 Forbidden — <!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en-US"><head><title>Just a moment...</title><meta http-equiv="Content-Ty); used recent-days page

bgeometrics.name: BGeometrics (bitcoin-data.com) free API
bgeometrics.frequency: daily; free tier withholds the latest ~7 days on some metrics
bgeometrics.method: SOPR and BTC supply in profit. Free tier: 15 requests/day — fetched at most once every 20 hours and carried forward between runs.

coingecko_global.name: CoinGecko /global
coingecko_global.method: Total crypto market cap and BTC dominance.

coingecko_markets.name: CoinGecko /coins/markets
coingecko_markets.method: Top-50 coins by market cap; stablecoins excluded for breadth.

coingecko_deriv.name: CoinGecko derivatives (aggregator)
coingecko_deriv.method: Per-market BTC perpetual OI (USD) and funding as reported to CoinGecko. Used for venues that geo-block direct access (Binance, Bybit) and for a market-wide total; methodology differs from direct venue APIs and is labelled "via CoinGecko".
